verdict: finalist (conditional) - lowest-capital, most delegable concept in DC: A-level list of 3,166 established 3-20 PU Chicago carriers, ~$650 / 6-10 weeks to an IL agency licence, prepaid compliance + renewal commission; promote only if a 10-risk market-access test and 5 paid compliance pilots pass within ~90 days
note: Base y3 op $20k (68 accts), y5 $172k; peak funding $36k no draw/$92k with draw. Compliance-only contribution ~$109/mo; insurance attach (E 25%) drives profit. Established carriers exit ~6-7%/yr. IL broker bond $2.5k+ (A).

verdict: reserve - 528 identifiable 10-100-unit private fleets and real precedent (Dickinson/Cox, Coltrain), but ~$7k/mo loaded tech vs ~$21k/mo revenue capacity leaves ~20-25% contribution per van; base FCF negative to yr3 and ~$0.43-0.55M cumulative funding with owned vans; revisit only with a partner lead tech and leased vans
note: Base y3 op $71k (60 fleets, 4 techs), y5 $104k; ~$100k before first revenue if van bought (~$45-50k leased). Rockford POs $66-190 per PM, $1,218 PM+repairs (A). Labor +20% -> y3 -$4k.

verdict: drop - inspection is cheap ($108-253/crane list; federal hoist re-bid fell from ~$15.2k/yr to $9.6k) and self-inspection is legal, so an 8-crane plant yields ~$5.6k/yr even with 2.5x repair pull-through; a $106k-loaded crane tech needs ~45 plants and base never covers tech + overhead within 5 years
note: Base y3 op -$38k (61 plants), y5 -$42k; peak funding $541k no draw/$733k with draw. Only optimistic ($750/plant, 125 plants) reaches $193k. 32 prospects incl. 7 documented crane users, 4 public buyers.
